name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessible bathroom remodel varies based on the scope and complexity of the project. A basic remodel might take 2-4 weeks, while a more extensive renovation involving layout changes, structural work, or custom features could extend to 6-8 weeks or longer. This timeline includes planning, material procurement, demolition, and construction phases. We provide a detailed project schedule after initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel duration varies from 2-4 weeks for basic projects to 6-8+ weeks for extensive renovations, depending on scope.
